about: DECLARED fields of each bridge component (what cannot be generated). scripts/bridge-manifest.js joins these with GENERATED fields (git refs, route tables extracted from source, test file counts, artifact hashes, projection-matrix losses) and marks the provenance of every field. Paths are relative to the parent directory of the repositories.

components.name: circle
components.role: the bridge: stateless composition of the other systems through SEURL move words; holds no records and no authority
components.research_status: IMPLEMENTED, TESTED; addressed transition (C-052) and recursive program construction (C-053) are HYPOTHESES
components.security_boundary: never holds credentials; rejects ?cap= (K-06); mutation only by POST; TALK = propose only; authority stays with PURL grants, ACSP capabilities, Golden seats, git rights
components.reconstruction_method: clone purl@branch, npm ci, npm test, resume checkpoint (scripts/bridge-cold-reconstruct.js)

components.name: purl-core
components.role: persistent versioned records (resources, events, grants); the circle's record store
components.security_boundary: owner grants authorise in-place update: the K-12 conflict (OBSERVED, experiments/axes/record-2.json)
components.reconstruction_method: event replay from the store files (checkpoint snapshots)

components.name: seurl
components.scope: index.html (halt page); executable FSM in purl/src/circle/seurl.js
components.security_boundary: a URL is a program, never a credential: possession of a SEURL grants nothing
components.reconstruction_method: deployment content hash = index.html @620ff95 (no git metadata on the deployment)

components.name: substrate
components.role: values, typed terms, executions, projections, observations; research registries

test_suite.command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . ; python3 -m tools.validate

components.research_status: IMPLEMENTED, TESTED; outputs of models are SIMULATED
components.security_boundary: runs locally; no credentials; runs/ is content-addressed and never edited
components.reconstruction_method: clone, run tests and tools.validate; executions are re-derivable (execution_hash per occurrence)

components.name: acsp
components.role: agent continuity: shared resources, proposals, capabilities, owner resolution

routes_from.pattern:
path === '

' in handleGet/handlePost; case '' in dispatchSub (/r/{id}/); POST regex /r/{id}/operations

components.security_boundary: capabilities in headers, never in URLs or logs; propose needs none; resolution is owner authority (K-18 UNRESOLVED)
components.reconstruction_method: clone, npm ci, npm run serve:local, vitest; live resource fixture circle/fixtures/acsp-live-*

components.name: golden-surface
components.role: embodied client: phone, relay, bus; the human-controlled surface

test_suite.command: python3 tests/*.py against a relay; npm test (purl) test/golden.test.js with FakePhone

components.research_status: BOUNDARY: FakePhone-tested only; a real Android WebView is not tested (not faked)
components.security_boundary: passwords never leave the phone; the agent loop (POST /bridge with a decider) is excluded; GET /ws upgrades to a bidirectional channel, so 'GET is safe' does not hold for it
components.reconstruction_method: relay is NOT MAPPABLE from the build environment (40.64.120.87 unreachable); FakePhone reproduces the protocol only

components.name: musa
components.role: specification sources and prototypes, outside the bridge

routes_from.reason: research/spec artifact; not executed by the bridge

test_suite.command: npm test (purl) test/musa.test.js (spec conformance of the circle)

components.research_status: SPECIFICATION; ramz seal accepts a recomputed forgery (SECURITY-FINDINGS SF-1)
components.security_boundary: never executed with credentials; ramz is not an integrity mechanism
components.reconstruction_method: clone; files are read as specification

components.name: luna-foundry
components.role: text-window service; source of the scroll@luna-foundry sense; not integrated with the circle
components.reconstruction_method: clone; Vercel deployment maps to 6a260ef by git metadata
